webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.addressMissing: No public address is configured for this deployment. Set CHANNEL_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL on the API.
webhook.notConnected: This account receives webhooks only after you subscribe a number below. Once a number is subscribed, incoming messages create conversations and delivery receipts update your messages; everything received is also kept exactly as sent.

connect.title: Connect WhatsApp Business
connect.description: Paste the WhatsApp Business Account ID and a system-user access token from Meta Business. The token is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
connect.accessTokenHint: Use a system-user token with whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging. Temporary tokens expire within hours.
connect.unverifiedNote: Without the app ID and secret the token cannot be inspected: its kind, expiry and permissions are shown as unverified.

errors.generic: Could not reach the provider. Try again.
errors.token_invalid: Meta rejected this token. Check that it is copied completely and has not expired.
errors.token_wrong_app: The token belongs to a different app than the App ID given.
errors.waba_no_access: This token cannot read the WhatsApp Business Account. Add the account to the system user's assets.
errors.app_secret_invalid: The app ID and secret do not match.

whatsapp.disconnectBody: The token is deleted and sending stops. Conversations and history stay.
whatsapp.receiptsNotice: Delivery and read receipts arrive only for numbers subscribed to this system (see “Webhooks” on each number); otherwise a sent message stays at “sent”.

webhookNumber.label: Webhooks

webhookNumber.takeOverBody: Events for this number now go to {{host}}. While you are subscribed, that service stops receiving this number's webhooks. Unsubscribing returns them.
webhookNumber.unreadable: Could not read the webhook state.
